attribution.note: Zitron states and endorses the assessment in his own words.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the margin ceiling, operating assumptions and hedged obsolescence clause. The firm economic assertions are observations; the value judgments and hedged clause cannot be scored.

contract.note: Gross margin is an ordinary contextual reading, and the latest generally reported quarter is a reasonable comparison period. However, the unspecified cost boundary affects any numerical verdict. The contract appropriately distinguishes depreciation from payback.

evidence.note: The audited company filing was available before the cutoff and documents a six-year equipment life. Its annual derived ratio covers a different period and excludes separately classified infrastructure costs. Neither that ratio nor the depreciation policy establishes the ceiling or required break-even period.

reviews.rationale: The packet supplies no comparable quarterly margin or project economics establishing or refuting the firm assertions under their stated assumptions. The annual 71.68% calculation is not a qualifying counterexample. A six-year accounting life does not establish six-year payback. The subjective descriptions and hedged obsolescence clause remain unscored.
